package.description: A digital photo manager designed for the GNOME desktop environment. It allows importing photos from disk or camera, organize them by keywords and events, view them in full-window or fullscreen mode, and more.

en-GB.description: A digital photo manager designed for the GNOME desktop environment. It allows importing photos from disk or camera, organise them by keywords and events, view them in full-window or fullscreen mode, and more.
en-GB.longDescription:
A digital photo manager designed for the GNOME desktop environment. It allows importing photos from disk or camera, organise them by keywords and events, view them in full-window or fullscreen mode, and more.

Note that as of 17 April 2026, the recentmost Windows version (0.7.2) lags far behind the recentmost Linux version (0.32.15).
en-GB.name: Shotwell
